recipes.name: ADAS
setup: Install requirements.txt in the selected environment; configure OPENAI_API_KEY through explicit environment_names.
Provide native dataset/ files; GPQA access and each benchmark license remain separate.

profiles.description: ADAS ARC agent-program search and native held-out evaluation

evaluation.description: ADAS ARC agent-program search and native held-out evaluation Metrics and validity retain the native evaluator contract.

argument_help: Native benchmark data paths and split sizes are configured by the matching search.py parser.
limitations: Source and fixture checks only; dependencies, paid model calls and native end-to-end execution are not verified. Native metrics are not canonical Arena task receipts.
Generated agent code executes in native Python; prepare the benchmark dataset and trusted isolation first.
